text:
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for release v2.7.1 -> prod (canary 10%) starting 2026-03-18T22:00Z
maria.g: noticed surge of 504s hitting /generate since ~21:50Z, looks like replica lag
ajay.k: confirmed, replica lag > 5s. ops looking into failover
ops-ron: running recovery on replica set, estimate ~90 minutes to stabilize
lisa: hold the canary for now? don't want to push to degraded DB
jonathan: @deploy-bot hold rollout (reason: DB incident)
deploy-bot: hold accepted for release v2.7.1 (initiator: jonathan)
ajay.k: ops estimate noted. suggestion: abort canary, pin prod traffic back to v2.7.0 until DB steady
emily: agree. also add a note in release notes about the pause and rollback path for CS
maria.g: if we pin to v2.7.0, we need to ensure cache keys are compatible (v2.7.1 changed dedupe key)
jonathan: quick mitigation: enable proxy compatibility mode so old keys work for a bit
jonathan: set: proxy.cache.compat_mode = true (applied in prod)
ajay.k: executing traffic pin: /deploy set-traffic prod --version v2.7.0 --reason "DB restore"
deploy-bot: traffic pin recorded: v2.7.0 at 2026-03-18T22:12Z. Canary aborted.
maria.g: drafting release note: "Rollout v2.7.1 paused due to DB replica restore. Canary aborted; traffic pinned to v2.7.0. New window to be scheduled after DB stability."
lisa: propose reschedule window 2026-03-19T05:00Z UTC — low traffic. ops?
ops-ron: that buffer works. we'll confirm when lag < 200ms for 10m before reattempt
ajay.k: will set new rollout_config: canary 5% initial, canary_wait 30m, add prechecks
deploy-bot: updated release config: { "release": "v2.7.1", "rollout_window": "2026-03-19T05:00Z", "canary": { "initial_percent": "5", "canary_wait_minutes": "30" }, "prechecks": ["smoke:generate:20m","db-lag-check:10m"] }
maria.g: adding smoke-check step to pipeline and a synthetic workload run for 20m before increasing canary
jonathan: add automatic fallback: if error_rate > 1% over 15m -> auto-revert to v2.7.0
emily: product and CS notified, looping compliance: @compliance
compliance: acknowledged, will review release notes for data-path impact
lisa: action list: (1) @ajay pin traffic (done), (2) @jonathan enable compat_mode (done), (3) @maria update release notes (in progress), (4) @ops-ron confirm DB stable
ops-ron: DB stable observed at 2026-03-19T00:10Z; replication lag < 150ms for 15m. marking green
ajay.k: running a dry-run at 04:30Z to validate prechecks
ajay.k: dry-run results: prechecks passed, smoke OK, no obvious regressions
deploy-bot: scheduled canary start for 2026-03-19T05:00Z (initial canary 5%)
maria.g: synthetic monitors running, dashboard watching key KPIs
jonathan: if anything spikes, /deploy rollback v2.7.0 and ping incidents channel
maria.g: will post final status after canary completes. closing hold for now :thumbsup:
